modalities.evidence: per-user longitudinal daily symptom monitoring data

output.population: 34 Israeli endometriosis patients monitored over 1-10 months
output.summary: Longitudinal daily symptom self-tracking by 34 Israeli endometriosis patients over 1-10 months, with onboarding patient information, individualized symptom sets and severity scales, and standardized mapping of symptoms to MedDRA.
